text: In Rome, the American diplomat Robert Thorn is told his newborn son has died and [secretly adopts another baby|wrong|broken trust], never telling his wife Katherine. Five years later in London, a Rottweiler appears at their home, Damien's nanny hangs herself at his birthday party, and a photographer finds [shadows in his photographs that foretell each death|rules|death sends warnings]. A priest insists the boy is [the son of Satan|threat|the devil and dark gods], and Robert is given seven daggers and a holy place to use them.
